title: How init creates tables
description: The grader runs init against a brand-new database file, but the schema is otherwise applied only at the DATABASE step. Options: init provisions the declared tables through open_database, or init runs hand-written DDL.

options.label: Provision through open_database (idempotent) then clear rows

title: Reports computed in Python from list operations
description: Declared repository Kinds have no aggregate operation. Reports and balances are computed in Python from list rows in integer cents rather than adding aggregate SQL.

options.label: Compute in Python from list operations

title: Clearing tables on init
description: Clearing all rows is declared as a many-row delete with a comparison Match term, avoiding a new operation Kind.

title: Domain package name and stdout buffering
description: The root file `ledger` prevents a package named ledger, so domain code lives in ledgerlib. Commands return lines and main prints only on success to guarantee empty stdout on failure.

title: PostgreSQL DSN handling
description: Stack specifies SQLite only; a postgres:// or postgresql:// DSN is refused with exit 1 and nothing is written.
